tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with products, inventory, transactions, users, suppliers, and alerts tables
Build Node.js/Express REST API with authentication, product CRUD, and inventory update endpoints
Implement WebSocket server for real-time inventory updates across connected clients
Create React mobile-first UI with Dashboard, Barcode Scanner, and Product Details screens
Integrate Barcode Scanner API with camera access and implement product lookup functionality
Build low stock alert system with automatic threshold monitoring and notification triggers
Implement Low Stock Alerts screen with filtering, mark-as-read, and reorder actions
Create product management interface for adding, editing, and deleting products with validation
Build transaction recording system to track sales, restocks, and inventory adjustments
Design and implement Settings screen with user profile, notification preferences, and threshold configuration
Implement role-based access control for Store Manager, Store Clerk, Store Owner, and Administrator roles
Create basic sales reporting with date range filtering and top products display

risks: WebSocket connection stability issues may cause real-time updates to fail on poor network conditions
Barcode Scanner API compatibility varies across mobile devices and may require fallback to manual entry
Concurrent inventory updates from multiple users could create race conditions without proper database locking
Performance degradation with large transaction history datasets if pagination and indexing not implemented early
User adoption challenges if barcode scanning UX is not intuitive and fast enough for store clerk workflows
